name: Engine Sensors
description: Crank and cam position, knock, oil pressure, oil level/temp, coolant temp, boost/TMAP and DI rail pressure sensors.

components.name: Crankshaft position sensor (58X)
components.description: Hall-effect sensor reading the 58X reluctor on the crank. Primary engine-speed/position input; failure stops the engine immediately.
components.location: Side of the block near the rear of the crank (verify exact side/position on your block).
installNotes: New O-ring lubed with oil; route harness away from starter/headers.
Perform crank variation relearn with scan tool after changes (if using GM ECM).

components.name: Camshaft position sensor (4X)
components.description: Hall sensor in the front timing cover reading the 4X target on the cam phaser; also used for VVT position feedback.
components.location: Front timing cover (Summit: cam sensor location = timing cover).

factory.name: GM Gen V CMP sensor
factory.notes: A VVT-delete (non-VVT gear) needs the BTR cam sensor conversion.

installNotes: New O-ring; ensure the sensor seats flush.

modelRef.features: Black probe with 1-bolt tab in the front cover above the phaser, reads the 4X target

components.name: Knock sensors
components.description: Piezo knock sensors on the block, one per bank, used for spark retard on detonation. On boosted race engines, accurate knock detection (or audio knock monitoring) is essential.
components.location: On the block, one per bank (verify exact positions on Gen V - not in the valley like Gen III).

hardware.notes: Gen IV LS knock-sensor value; no published Gen V value found. Checked 2026-10: GM SI fastener table for the C7 LT1 (screenshots reposted on CorvetteForum) lists 'Knock Sensor Bolts 25 N·m (18 lb ft)'. The 2016-18 Camaro SM (via TightTorque) agrees.

installNotes: Mount surface must be clean and flat; never use washers or sealant.

modelRef.features: Flat piezo donut with a centre bolt and a short pigtail; one each side of the block below the exhaust ports

components.name: Oil pressure sensor
components.description: Pressure transducer on the main oil gallery used by the ECM to command the variable-displacement pump and for the gauge. Race cars add a dedicated logger sensor via a tee or remote block.
components.location: On the block main gallery (verify location on your Gen V block).

factory.name: GM Gen V oil pressure sensor

hardware.threadlocker: Thread sealant if tapered thread / O-ring if ORB

installNotes: Avoid heavy adapters hanging off the sensor port - vibration cracks fittings; use a remote-mount block.

components.name: Manifold (boost) pressure / TMAP & supercharger pressure sensors
components.description: LT4 uses a TMAP after the intercooler (on the supercharger housing) and a supercharger inlet/outlet pressure sensor for boost/bypass control. Magnuson’s blower provides a TMAP port that accepts the OEM LT4 sensor.

factory.name: GM LT4 TMAP and supercharger outlet pressure sensor
factory.notes: GM IAT 12614717 cited by Magnuson for its housing.

hardware.notes: Lube O-ring with Super Lube (Magnuson). Checked 2026-10: GM SI fastener table for the C7 LT1 (screenshots reposted on CorvetteForum) lists 'Map Sensor Bolt 4.5 N·m (40 lb in)'. The LT4 TMAP uses the same screw-retained O-ring style, so the GM value applies when the sensor is fitted in the Magnuson port. CORRECTED from an 89 in-lb estimate, which risks cracking the sensor flange.
